title: Sandbagging Detection on a New Capability Domain (Cyber vs Bio vs Math)

original_idea.body: # Sandbagging Detection on a New Capability Domain. Prompt an open model to sandbag on a math benchmark, apply MALT-style detection, compare AUROC to WMDP-domain numbers. Twist = domain swap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Detector domain-transfer gap maps to dangerous-capability eval reliability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompted sandbagging + existing detector on public benchmarks; mentor-guided feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused domain-swap comparison with AUROC metric; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models/data, eval-reliability auditing labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Prompted inference on open model over a benchmark subset, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Sandbagging detection studied; math-domain transfer twist plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Domain-transfer of sandbagging detectors plausibly under-studied.
